description: Company profile from a domain: a one-line summary, what the company does, founded, headquarters, industry, employee count, founders, parent company, public listing (ticker, exchange, SEC business address and industry), key pages (pricing, docs, contact, careers, status), social profiles, current prices with the date seen, tech stack, role contact emails, domain age and mail provider, and AI-readiness. From the company's own website plus Wikidata, SEC EDGAR, RDAP and DNS.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL, e.g. "stripe.com".
